title: Give criteria for prioritising and sequencing components
requirements:
- Indicate which components are a baseline and which become relevant by national goals and maturity
- Present the Client Registry as frequent but not default; selection follows use-case dependencies and risk
- Introduce criteria such as use-case urgency and dependency centrality
- State recurrence is one factor and add criteria such as readiness, dependency risk, equity and cost
- Describe it as required where priority use cases need person matching, with a proportionality test
- Qualify 'no less essential' for the business-services layer so not every country needs every component
- Note identity reconciliation prerequisites (profiling, matching quality, adjudication)
